what: Several large circle outlines behind the dark Hero (sticking out beyond the board) are pushed, rotated and stretched following the cursor. The cursor position is measured from −1 to 1 relative to the board center. For each circle, push is nx·ny × 44px (second 26px, opposite direction), rotation is nx × 6° (second −4°), and stretch is 1 + |n| × .05 (second .035). Push and stretch follow over 1.1s and rotation over 1.4s with power3, so the two circles sway out of step, and they return to place when the cursor leaves the board. On touch devices they drift slowly on sine round trips of 7s and 9s (1.5s more for each circle) at 60% (horizontal) and 45% (vertical) of that range

options.data-amp · data-rot · data-dir · data-st: Each ring gets its own set offset (px), rotation (°), direction (1/−1) and stretch — if unset, the first and second use the original values and the third onward reuse the second
options.[data-fx-part=ring]: Circle — position and size come from the consuming css (original: 103rem · 83rem squares shifted −62% · −67% / −49% · −52% from the panel center)

from.where: service.html .nd-shero (two circles behind the treatment Hero — original s-hero-js: config [{amp 44, rot 6, dir 1, stretch .05}, {amp 26, rot −4, dir −1, stretch .035}] · quickTo x·y·scale 1.1 / rotation 1.4 power3 · touch drift 7+1.5i / 9+1.5i sine.inOut yoyo)
